mapper.select: select id, goods_id, image_url, oss_object_key, sort_order, create_time, update_time from sku_image where goods_id = #{goodsId} order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sku_image(goods_id, image_url, oss_object_key, sort_order) values(#{goodsId}, #{imageUrl}, #{ossObjectKey}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.delete: delete from sku_image where goods_id = #{goodsId} and id = #{id}
